subs: One simple rule. If your neighbor has a bigger army than you... it invades you. And then it does it again. And again.
Every round, the strongest neighbor wins. Who will be left at the end?
Round 1. If your neighbor is a hundred times stronger than you... it invades you.
22 countries are marked. Bhutan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia.
The United States swallows the Bahamas.
Round 2. If your neighbor is forty times stronger than you... it invades you.
20 countries are marked. Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Laos.
Round 3. If your neighbor is twenty times stronger than you... it invades you.
27 countries are marked. Nepal, Canada, the Dominican Republic.
The United States swallows the Dominican Republic.
Round 4. If your neighbor is ten times stronger than you... it invades you.
34 countries are marked. Afghanistan, Taiwan, Myanmar.
Round 5. If your neighbor is five times stronger than you... it invades you.
47 countries are marked. South Korea, Vietnam, Thailand.
Round 6. If your neighbor is three times stronger than you... it invades you.
24 countries are marked. Pakistan, Iran, Indonesia.
Round 7. If your neighbor is twice as strong as you... it invades you.
8 countries are marked. India, the United States, North Korea.
Round 8. If your neighbor is one and a half times stronger than you... it invades you.
7 countries are marked. Ukraine, Ethiopia, Egypt.
China, Morocco and Sierra Leone. They are all neighbors now. Time for the final battles.
The final duel. China against Morocco.
China is the last country standing.
Who is the strongest neighbor of your country?
question: WHO'S YOUR COUNTRY'S
STRONGEST NEIGHBOR?
